Name: Miku Mod Plus Chinese Translation
Author: OuShiwen
Description:
[color=#f4f4f4][size=3]概要 Overview[/size][/color]
本模组为 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29201]Miku Mod Plus[/url] 进行了中文翻译。﻿ ﻿﻿
This module has a Chinese translation for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29201]Miku Mod Plus[/url].

[size=3]前置 Required Mod[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29201][size=2]自定义NPC_Miku Miku Npc Plus[/size][/url] ﻿
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]内容修补程序 Content Patcher[/url]﻿ [/size]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]农舍修复 Farmhouse Fixes[/url]
[*][size=2]﻿[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][size=2]通用模组配置单 GMCM[/size][/url]﻿
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]肖像 Portraiture[/url]﻿﻿
[/list]
[size=3]用法 Usage[/size]
    ①.下载并解压文件到能轻松找到的地方。 
[list]
[*]Download and upzip translation file somewhere you can easily find it.
[/list]    ②.将本模组的中文翻译文件[color=#00ffff]zh.json[/color]放入原模组的[color=#00ffff]i18n文件夹[/color]中。
[list]
[*]Move the Chinese translation file [color=#00ffff]zh.json[/color] of this module to the[color=#9fc5e8] [/color][color=#00ffff]i18n folder[/color] of the original module.
[/list]
